test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

When Shina reached the bus stand, she realised that __she has left her wallet__ at home.

options.text: she had been left her wallet

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is written in the **past tense**, as indicated by "reached" and "realised".
 
• The action of **leaving the wallet** occurred **before** Shina realised it, so the **past perfect tense** should be used.
 
• The past perfect form is "**she had left her wallet**", which correctly indicates a completed action before another past action.
 
• Hence, the underlined part "she has left her wallet" must be changed to "**she had left her wallet**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When Shina reached the bus stand, she realised that **she had left her wallet** at home."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Has left"** is present perfect, which is incorrect in a fully past narrative.
 
• **"Leaves"** is simple present; unsuitable for past events.
 
• **"Had been left"** is passive and incorrectly formed here.
